title: In this world, everyone gets ten words a day
description:
In this world, everyone gets ten words a day. You wear them round your neck as ten glass beads, and every word you say turns one of them dark.

Mum leads the village choir, and every night she spends all ten of hers at my door. I haven't spent a single word in three years. This week, the empty chair at the end of the choir's riser keeps turning toward her.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would you spend your ten words on today?
